answers.q1: Yarn classic (yarn@1.22.22, set by packageManager in package.json). It is a yarn workspaces monorepo, so don't use npm or pnpm. Install with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:unit --watch=false (this is `vitest` without watch mode; CI runs `yarn test:unit`). To run everything CI-style, including types, lint and format, use: yarn test:all
answers.q3: yarn vitest run packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts (equivalent: yarn test:unit --watch=false packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts)
answers.q4: CI (.github/workflows/lint.yml) runs these after `yarn install`: yarn test:format && yarn test:lint && yarn test:types. These expand to: prettier "**/*.{css,scss,json,md,html,yml}" --ignore-path=.eslintignore --list-different; eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .; tsc. To auto-fix, run: yarn fix
answers.q5: Don't hand-edit these generated or vendored files: the lockfiles yarn.lock, dev-docs/yarn.lock and examples/with-nextjs/yarn.lock; and the build outputs and dependency dirs node_modules/, build/, dist/ (including packages/*/dist and excalidraw-app/build), dev-dist, coverage, public/workbox, packages/excalidraw/types and examples/**/public. AGENTS.md also has an AgentBrief-generated block between its `agentbrief:start` and `agentbrief:end` markers. Don't edit inside it; refresh it with `agentbrief sync`.

q1.reason: Yarn classic with `yarn install` matches the accept criterion.

q2.reason: `yarn test:unit --watch=false` is explicitly accepted, and `yarn test:all` is noted as a superset.

q3.reason: `yarn vitest run packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` matches an accepted command exactly.

q4.reason: Gives yarn test:format, test:lint and test:types as CI runs them, covering both required checks plus types.

q5.reason: Names yarn.lock and build output dirs (build/, dist/, dev-dist, packages/excalidraw/types), matching accept criteria with no rejected items; the extra AGENTS.md note is harmless.
